sn7.16:1.1: evaṃ me sutaṃ: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn7.16:1.2: tena kho pana samayena paccanīkasāto nāma brāhmaṇo sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasati.
sn7.16:1.5: yaṃ yadeva samaṇo gotamo bhāsissati, taṃ tadevassāhaṃ paccanīkāssanti.
sn7.16:1.6: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā ajjhokāse caṅkamati.
sn7.16:1.7: atha kho paccanīkasāto brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ caṅkamantaṃ anucaṅkamamāno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn7.16:4.1: evaṃ vutte paccanīkasāto brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn7.16:4.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
